subject: Five ABB arms with vacuum grippers unloading float glass from a long roller conveyor in a factory hall; wide, symmetrical, no people
author: ICAPlants
notes: Best pick. Original 3072x2304 (4:3), resized to 2400. Crops well to 16:9 or wider. Only branding is ABB on the robots (maker, not operator). Credit: 'ICAPlants, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons'.

subject: Four KUKA palletizing arms stacking bread crates at a German bakery distribution floor, elevated wide view
author: KUKA Roboter GmbH, Bachmann
notes: Original 3417x2563, resized to 2400. Sharp, warm orange palette that matches the site's ember accent. KUKA lettering on the arms (robot maker); small product labels on bread bags are not legible at page size. No credit required, but courtesy credit suggested.
